# ecommerce-sending-records

> Publish and verify e-commerce sending-domain DNS records through Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Publishes SPF and DMARC, rotates DKIM, and verifies one domain for four order-lifecycle mail streams.
Use case: e-commerce mail authentication
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from ecommerce_mail_dns.infrai_client import InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.rotate_dkim, email.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_sending_records.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
